trap.label: reporting verb
trap.wrong: The team said me that it works.
trap.right: The team told me that it works.
trap.why: Em português "disse-me". Em inglês tell + pessoa.

mcq.q: Reporting: The team said ___ it works.

fix.wrong: The scientist explained me the data.
fix.right: The scientist explained the data to me.

fix.wrong: The study is thought to being valid.
fix.right: The study is thought to be valid.

fix.wrong: Sample size was small, but it was enough.
fix.right: The sample size was small, but it was enough.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para a passiva: “Scientists tested the drug.”
Reescreva com said: “‘It works,’ the team said.”
rewrite.answer: The team said that it worked.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “The result is likely to change.”
rewrite.answer: The result is likely to change.
